## Type of change

## If this is a new skill

- [ ] I opened a Skill Request issue first and the maintainer agreed it fits
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter passes `agentskills validate`
- [ ] Description is under 1024 characters and double-quoted
- [ ] Bundle includes `README.md`, `HOWTO.md` with recipes, and at least one worked example
- [ ] I updated the root `README.md` to include the new skill and bumped the count
- [ ] I updated `docs/lovable-homepage-prompt.md` to add a card and bump the pillar count
- [ ] I added a launch blog post to `blog/` (optional but appreciated)

## If this is a fix to an existing skill

- [ ] I explained what was wrong and how the fix changes the output
- [ ] If the change affects the public shape, I updated all referring docs

## Voice check

- [ ] No emojis
- [ ] Workhorse voice — practical, restrained, no hype
- [ ] Read three existing skills to match the voice if I'm new
